verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a first-party Stripe Directory that helps AI agents find external providers for a task and provision or use them. A 'stripe-directory' agent skill is listed in the live, keyless well-known skills index. The evidence is a single thin doc line, though, and nothing ties the directory to payable machine-payment (MPP/x402) endpoints or describes how an agent queries it. Missing for 10: documentation that the directory indexes payable services/APIs specifically, a machine-readable query interface or listing schema, how providers get listed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent discovery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can discover payable services and APIs through a published directory or discovery index

citations.quote: Stripe Directory helps developers and AI agents find the best external providers for a task and follow the best supported path to provision or use them.
https://docs.stripe.com/.well-known/skills/index.json returns the JSON index of Stripe-maintained agent skills (connect-recommend, stripe-best-practices, stripe-directory, ...)
